Plot star or radar chart of wind cardinal directions

Source: R/data_functions.R
plot_wind.Rd

Plot star or radar chart of wind cardinal directions

Usage

plot_wind(winddir, windspeed)

Arguments

winddir

wind direction 3D Spatraster

windspeed

windspeed 3D Spatraster of same geometry as winddir

Value

plots star charts showing frequency of wind directions and of average and maximum windspeeds by direction

Examples

wdir<-c(357,5,20,45,100,185,265,275,290)
wspeed<-seq(3,27,3)
plot_wind(wdir,wspeed)
